lead: One large tile leads and the others fill the grid around it. Use it when one feature matters most; use the feature grid when they are equal.

tiles.title: The lead tile takes two cells
tiles.text: It gets a larger title as well, so the layout says what matters before anyone reads a word. Only the first tile leads, and only where three columns fit.

tiles.title: Three columns on wide screens
tiles.text: Two on tablets, where the lead tile has the first row to itself, and one on phones.

tiles.title: The rest are standard cards
tiles.text: Icon, title and a sentence or two: the same card as in the feature grid.

tiles.title: Any tile can link
tiles.text: The whole tile becomes the target, and its title names the link for screen readers.

tiles.title: No gap at the end
tiles.text: When the count would leave a hole in the last row, the last tile widens to close it.
